an4.105:5.7: lokasminti → ito paraṃ chaṭṭhasuttaṃ naṭṭhaṃ khāyati. tathā hi vuttaṃ tabbaṇṇanāyaṃ pañcame āmaṃ pakkavaṇṇīti āmakaṃ hutvā olokentānaṃ pakkasadisaṃ khāyati. evaṃ sabbapadāni daṭṭhabbāni. chaṭṭhaṃ uttānameva. sattame gādhaṃ vuccati visayo yo ca gādhaṃ khanati na ca tattha vasati so gādhaṃ kattā no vasitāti vuccatīti. dissamānapotthakesu pana taṃ naṭṭhameva hoti.
